MEDIASHARINGD(8) System Manager's Manual MEDIASHARINGD(8)

NAME

mediasharingd — The media sharing daemon

SYNOPSIS

mediasharingd

DESCRIPTION

mediasharingd is a per-user daemon which manages the user's media library sharing.

There are no configuration options to mediasharingd. Users should not run mediasharingd manually.
